# DragBuilder

> DragBuilder is a no-code app builder. Its built-in AI generates an app's
> screens, data model and logic from a plain-language description; you then
> refine anything by dragging and dropping — no code is written at any
> point. One project builds for Desktop (macOS, Windows, Linux), Android,
> iPhone and the Web.

## Key facts

- Free to start, no credit card required.
- Not a prototype tool: what you build is a real, functioning app, not a mockup or a preview.
- Projects are exportable — nothing proprietary keeps you locked in.
- The desktop app is available for macOS, Windows and Linux; DragBuilder also runs directly in the browser.

## Pages

- [Home](https://dragbuilder.io/): product overview, features, FAQ, download links.
- [Docs](https://docs.dragbuilder.io/): documentation for building with DragBuilder.
- [Open app](https://app.dragbuilder.io/): try DragBuilder directly in the browser.
